title: University schema: keys and references
purpose: Make university table schemas and thirteen foreign key directions legible with explicit composite keys; distinguish non-FK time-slot association.
alt: 대학교 스키마 11개 테이블의 기본키·속성, 13개 외래키 참조와 시간대 연관 관계
requiredChecks: Exactly eleven table cards: student, instructor, department, advisor, course, prereq, section, classroom, time_slot, takes, teaches. Each card has exact PK and other attributes as specified.
All primary key attribute names are underlined and identified as PK. section PK course_id/sec_id/semester/year; takes and teaches PK additionally ID; time_slot PK time_slot_id/day/start_time.

People/course references: student.dept_name → department.dept_name ; instructor.dept_name → department.dept_name ; course.dept_name → department.dept_name ; advisor.s_ID → student.ID ; advisor.i_ID → instructor.ID ; section.course_id → course.course_id ; section.(building, room_number) → classroom.(building, room_number) ; prereq.course_id → course.course_id ; prereq.prereq_id → course.course_id. Arrows point FK→referenced key, not reverse.
takes has exactly two FK groups ID→student and four-column section key→section; teaches ID→instructor and same section key→section.
time_slot_id alone is not unique under this composite key; section.time_slot_id↔time_slot.time_slot_id is explicitly association only, not a foreign key. No time_slot→section FK is invented.
prompt:
Use case scientific-educational. Generate a NEW original English raster schema reference diagram for an IT study blog, white background, navy monospaced identifier text, blue/teal cards, generous whitespace, no copied textbook layout. Title "University schema: keys and references". Large wide landscape canvas with LEFT 60% TABLE CARD GRID and RIGHT 40% REFERENCE REGISTER. Do NOT draw a tangled web of connectors across cards. Eleven cards in a clean three-column four-row grid; each card has heading table name, line "PK: ..." with ALL listed primary key attribute names UNDERLINED, and separate line "Other: ..." if nonempty. Exact cards:
student | PK: ID | Other: name, dept_name, tot_cred
instructor | PK: ID | Other: name, dept_name, salary
department | PK: dept_name | Other: building, budget
advisor | PK: s_ID | Other: i_ID
course | PK: course_id | Other: title, dept_name, credits
prereq | PK: course_id, prereq_id
section | PK: course_id, sec_id, semester, year | Other: building, room_number, time_slot_id
classroom | PK: building, room_number | Other: capacity
time_slot | PK: time_slot_id, day, start_time | Other: end_time
takes | PK: ID, course_id, sec_id, semester, year | Other: grade
teaches | PK: ID, course_id, sec_id, semester, year
RIGHT register heading "Foreign keys (FK → referenced key)". EXACT thirteen reference rows, generously spaced; wrap composite references onto two lines without splitting field names. Each row's text itself contains one right-facing arrow:
student.dept_name → department.dept_name
instructor.dept_name → department.dept_name
course.dept_name → department.dept_name
advisor.s_ID → student.ID
advisor.i_ID → instructor.ID
section.course_id → course.course_id
section.(building, room_number) → classroom.(building, room_number)
prereq.course_id → course.course_id
prereq.prereq_id → course.course_id
takes.ID → student.ID
takes.(course_id, sec_id, semester, year) → section.(course_id, sec_id, semester, year)
teaches.ID → instructor.ID
teaches.(course_id, sec_id, semester, year) → section.(course_id, sec_id, semester, year)
BOTTOM distinct pale-grey note card "Time-slot association (not an FK)" with text "section.time_slot_id ↔ time_slot.time_slot_id" and smaller "time_slot_id alone is not unique; the time_slot primary key also includes day and start_time." Legend "Underlined attributes: primary key". Preserve exact spelling and grouping. No table rows of sample data, no extra tables, no artificial FK from time_slot to section. Readability is more important than decorative arrows. Entire long composite references must fit unclipped.
